notes.title: Update 11/03/2022 - Version 1.0.1.2 (9863688)
notes.content:
Hey guys!
I just released a new update for TOGUM,
The game is now much more optimized, smaller, with new content and bug fixes :)

[b]NOVIDADES:[/b]

[b]1 - More optimized and smaller game:[/b]
I managed to reduce more 800 MB of the game, keeping it in the total size of 4.3 GB.
The game has also been optimized to improve the number of frames per second and reduce camera glitches. You will notice that the game is much lighter to play, especially on the map outside Priscilla's house.

However, this update will uninstall and reinstall your game, I apologize for the inconvenience but it was the only way I managed to make the optimization happen, so its size is 4.3 gb.


[b]2 - Added the Codex:[/b]
The CODEX was added to the main menu, there you can see the main characters and a little more about Priscilla and Erika's history.

I also added Sayonara's father: Ramon Martinez, he was also added to the game and is a character you can talk to :)


[b]3 - Save/Load:[/b]
Now if you're in the neighborhood, you can save anywhere you want and not just at Priscilla's house.
Also added an option to load your last Save in the Menu.


[b]4 - There are now "notes" scattered around town with tips and a bit of game's lore[/b]

5 - Added a new outfit for Priscilla the "Fighter Outfit". The outfit is the same one worn by Danielle in the first version of the game. And if you want, you can also keep using the school uniform.


[b]Bugs fixes:[/b]

1 - Fixed a bug that caused Priscilla to appear at the ending with her school outfit even though you had chosen another outfit for her.

2 - Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash at random times if you talked to Sayonara and entered Priscilla's house later.

3 - Fixed the bug that caused the ambient sound to sometimes not play.

4 - Fixed a bug that if you tried to activate the pad while running, the "Back" button would get stuck on the screen.


[b] Known bugs:[/b]

1 - There is a small bug in Priscilla's left eye in the skin (Fighter). It will be fixed in a future update.

notes.title: TOGUM is back baby!
notes.content:
Hi guys!
As some of you already saw, i started to work on TOGUM again^^  Yeah.. it wasn't easy, i had very difficult times as some of you already know, and with that i would like to thank you all who sent me messages wishing good things, i felt a lot of love and i can't thank you all enough, on mine and my family's behalf, thank you!^^ 

[b]So here's what changed and what to expect:[/b]

[h1]About the Episodes[/h1]
At first, i wanted TOGUM to be a big and long game, but after some time thinking, i saw that was only going to add things i didn't wanted to, or extend the story without context.

So, now i decided to do [b]everything in only one main chapter[/b] called "Episode 0 - Until Dawn"', i can't say why  i decided that name because that would be an spoiler lol.

If you guys like the format and the story, i plan to do a [b]New Game +[/b] and if everything goes fine, i will create a DLC chapter later, but don't worry it will be totally free as i promised before.

The episode 0 it was my first and original idea for game.

[h1]Gameplay and new protagonist?[/h1]

You guys can see now that there's a new face on the promos right? That's Priscilla Wu, and she is the protagonist of the Episode 0. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38603883/9aeba938a2d2f5ee505052a0bacdfae4a8eb53ba.png[/img]

The gameplay will be focused on the story, there's no battles for now but there's a new[b] Stealth Mode.[/b] who is avaiable in some parts of the game and some puzzles to solve, so i hope you enjoy.


[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

1 - I reduced the game's [b]INSANE SIZE[/b] of [b]21 GB to 5 GB[/b], i'm not totally happy yet and i think i can reduce more.

2 - I reduced the loading time and found the bug that made the game don't finish load and then start to load again.

3 - Fixed the collisions.


[h1]Answering some questions:[/h1]

[b]1 - The game have some songs I've heard, are you allowed to use them?[/b]


Yeah, all of them^^ And the new version have a music composed for the game itself^^

[b]2 - Why you changed the company name from "Guaiamu Studio" to "Dieggo Masamune"?[/b]

That's because i changed my artistic name as well. I work as a 3D artist and "Guaiamu Studio" was my artistic name until some time ago. When i created TOGUM's page i was still using it and as i was going to retire the game and didn't knew if or when i was going to come back, i decided to change to my new name. Now i decided to use both.


[b]3 - The characters who appeared on the first version will appear too?[/b]

Most of them will, some are in the trailer already ^^


[b]4 - When this new version will be released then?[/b]

It's already live! You can purchase/download the new version on the game's main page ^^

That's it, i hope you guys enjoy.

--
WE ARE TOGUM

notes.title: Why TOGUM was removed from STEAM
notes.content:
Hello guys, Dieggo Masamune here.

I'm really sorry for my absence, this post will be a little personal, but I owe you all a explanation:

As some of you know, TOGUM was beign made by a single person (me), and unfortunately i'm not on my best moment lately. 

I lost my dad recently to the corona virus... he had 45 days of suffering on the hospital.. and i even couldn't give him a farewell goodbye.. i still can't.

All that was devastating for me and my family, and we are still trying to go back to our normal... 
With that, i can't focus on the game entirely, as there's so much things to do and you guys deserve a cool and fun game to play... so i couldn't let it on the store on as the way it was...

It's not fair keep selling the game if the people will not enjoy and have a good time. I can assure you guys that there is no legal problems on the game as everything was made by me or used with permission of it's owners. Models, sounds, musics and even the easter eggs.

I thought I could keep working on it, but I couldn't ...
One day i just stopped... i don't opened my project until now. I had to ask my boss to go to a vacation because even my daily work has been hard to do it, i was having so many breakdowns i was worried.

I know most of you are not happy with the game, which I respect and understand perfectly (i truly do!), so with all that, i decided to removed it from STEAM. 


CREATION:

For people who are curious, i made TOGUM alone in 3 years, it was my first real experience on UNREAL ENGINE and game development, and even with the game not being a success, i really enjoyed and had fun doing it.​

At first i had only experience on 3D modelling, so TOGUM was a challenge.

I made everything: the models, the programming, both c++ and blueprints, the animations (i know i have to improve them a lot), most illustrations and the maps... It was hard but it was a cool experience, and experience is something you will always carry with you, it helps you to improve.


THANKS:

Thanks a lot for all the supportive messages you guys sent me, i'm sorry couldn't answer all of them.. sometimes is hard be in the front of the computer... but i saw most of them, and i'm very grateful for your support and hints of how i could improve the game.

I can't thank enough the people who helped me to do it and i'm sorry if TOGUM wasn't the game you guys wanted, it never was my intention to bring you a bad game or story. I only wanted to show what i made.

And if i can be personal again, if you have time, show your parents how much you love and respect them while you guys are still together.. be supportive and take care of them..

Sorry i didn't made this post earlier, it's difficult to talk about it.. even now.

TOGUM's future is uncertain, but thank you for your support and all the kind messages.
I hope you guys still follow my work and still give me a chance as a indie game developer.

Stay Safe and thanks for reading so far!
----

Dieggo Masamune
